title: Campaign owner producer pins verify current file bytes without binding the imported implementation
cause: package_root producer bytes are read at preparation time and compared with root bytes. There is no import-time byte snapshot. A long-lived process imported from version A can accept a plan pinning newly changed version B when both compared paths now contain B, while executing A.
reproduction: Load frozen source74a44860 from a private package copy; append a deterministic comment to that private on-disk module after import; author the private fixture and producer bindings from the changed file0cb706d2. prepare and dry-run apply accept, although the known executing import source hash differs from the pinned producer hash. No owner application is needed.
required_fix: Bind loaded operator and relevant imported dependency bytes at import time, compare all accepted producer pins to that actual loaded snapshot and original file identities at preparation and late boundaries; test stale import and unchanged positives. Keep fixtures private and preserve original failing evidence.
limitations: No claim of actual scientific data corruption; demonstrated false provenance acceptance. No maintained files or author files were modified.
